thread:
Anna (PM): Heads-up — ACME is asking for on-prem model routing parity with CompetitorX by EoQ. They want identical tenant routing controls and per-route SLOs. Asking if we can commit to that for their pilot.
Devon (Eng): Do they mean full feature parity or just the routing API surface?
Anna (PM): They described: same API endpoints + identical behavior for fallbacks and model variants. Also want canary rollout and rollback hooks.
Maria (Sales): ACME is willing to sign a 12mo Dedicated commit if we ship the parity work in the pilot window. This is a potential anchor account.
Sam (Design): Curious how much UX work: admin UI for per-route toggles + rollout visualizations. Could be a focused set of screens.
Kai (Data): Need to check telemetry impact — per-route metrics at 99th will increase cardinality. We should quantify cost.
Devon (Eng): Rough engineering estimate: baseline API parity ~6w, canary + rollback automation + UI hooks + docs ~3w. That's 9w total. If we scope to API-only + minimal flags we could do 5w.
Mike (Prod Lead): Important trade: parity gets the sale but costs eng cycles that delay other differentiators (quality-based routing, cost-aware pooling). Need criteria for yes/no.
Anna (PM): Proposed decision matrix: if ACME commits >= $X/month and legal ok with pilot timeline, we prioritize parity. Otherwise we offer a supported compatibility shim + product roadmap slot. Thoughts?
Maria (Sales): We can push for $X = $60k/mo reserved commit. ACME likely to accept with an enterprise discount.
Devon (Eng): We need clearer launch criteria. Without canary automation we risk rollouts. If sales can hit $60k then we can add 2w buffer for shippable canary.
Sam (Design): For a trimmed scope we can deliver CLI-level toggles and a single admin page for rollout state. That cuts UI time in half.
Kai (Data): Telemetry cost estimate: extra 30% metric volume in the pilot org. Will need retention tradeoffs.
Anna (PM): To keep this pragmatic, propose two lanes: 
1) Minimal parity lane (API + flags + docs) — 5w, sales-led pilot, no UI, limited telemetry retention.
2) Full parity lane (API + canary automation + UI + telemetry) — 9w, requires commit >= $60k/mo.

Devon (Eng): I can scope minimal parity tasks: 
```
- implement routing API compatibility layer
- fallback behavior for model variants (config-driven)
- basic auth/ACL checks for on-prem tenant
- docs + integration tests
```

Anna (PM): Launch criteria (draft):
```
- API compatibility: request/response parity for routing endpoints
- Integration tests against ACME pilot scenarios
- Canary deployment capability (full lane only)
- Ops runbook for rollback and incident playbook
- Legal/ security signoff for pilot VPC
```

Mike (Prod Lead): Also include measurable guardrails: no more than +10% latency p50 and clear cost delta communicated.
Maria (Sales): ACME asked for a hard date — EoQ. Can we realistically hit EoQ for minimal lane?
Devon (Eng): EoQ yes for minimal lane if we start next week and freeze scope. Full lane likely misses by 2-3w.
Sam (Design): I'll prepare mockups for the single admin page this week — low fidelity first.
Kai (Data): I'll prepare a telemetry plan and cost delta projection by Fri.
Anna (PM): Decision request: approve sprint deferral and allocate a 2-sprint eng focus to parity-minimal if sales secures $30k/mo pilot commitment; upgrade to full parity if $60k/mo guaranteed.
Maria (Sales): I'll push for $60k, will take the $30k fallback if needed.
Mike (Prod Lead): Approved conditional on a named SLA in contract and on-call coverage for rollout week.
Anna (PM): Great. Action items:
- Maria: negotiate commit and return with written term by Tue (@Maria)
- Devon: write RFC for minimal parity tasks; include test matrix by Wed (@Devon)
- Sam: mockups by Thu (@Sam)
- Kai: telemetry + cost note by Fri (@Kai)
- Mike: prepare ops runbook template (@Mike)

ops-bot: Incident policy template created: https://internal.redwood/ops/templates/rollback-runbook :thumbsup:

Anna (PM): Thanks everyone — will reconvene Thurs after updates. :calendar:
summary: Decision thread: scope two lanes (minimal parity vs full parity) for ACME pilot; pricing thresholds ($30k/$60k) determine scope; action items assigned; timeline notes and launch criteria drafted.
